question_text: Some states have more representatives than other states. Why?

why_it_matters.text: Larger states get more Congressional representatives because more people live there. This is the 'proportional' part of representation, it is balanced by the Senate, where every state has 2 senators regardless of size.

fun_fact.text: The Constitution promises every state at least 1 representative — no matter how small. So Wyoming, with 580,000 people, gets 1. California, with 39 million, gets 52.
